comparison.objective: Remove a supported optical instrument from packaging and place it safely on a matching stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Support-aware transfer, coordinated removal of protective parts, and low-tilt handling.
comparison.success_condition: Instrument stably supported on its stand without excessive tilt/drop, with cap and cradle placed in the tray; the body lacks a complete numeric rubric beyond reported tilt/drop checks.
comparison.reason: Safe transfer of an intact fragile instrument does not test impact delivery, notch fracture, retained-coil protection, or loose metal fragment search and containment.
